risks.risk: Lot may be incomplete vs the stated list (missing axle shafts and/or starter motor).
risks.proof: Ask for clear photos of each item: both axle shafts laid out (showing length/ends), the starter motor (label/part shape), plus the steering rack and radiator from separate angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price the lot as worst-case: only the visible steering rack/gear and radiator/condenser, with the rest treated as not included.

risks.risk: Radiator/condenser may be damaged (bent fins, leaks, cracked tanks) reducing scrap value and any repair value.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of the radiator/condenser end tanks and full fin surface (including any dents), plus a quick water-hose leak test video if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: damaged/unsellable for repair, scrap-only.

risks.risk: Steering rack/gear may be seized, leaking, or missing internal parts; boots may be torn.
risks.proof: Request close-ups of both ends/boots and any visible leaks, and a short video showing whether the rack moves smoothly (even if sold as-is).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: not functional and suitable only for scrap/parts.

risks.risk: The stated total weight (500 kg) may not match what you receive; weight affects scrap pricing.
risks.proof: Request a photo of the certified scale reading with the full items on it (or a receipt), and/or a video of the weighing process.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: weight not guaranteed; treat as the visible items only.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: steering rack/axle shafts/radiator may not fit your vehicle model.
risks.proof: Request the vehicle make/model/year the parts came from, or part numbers/labels (photos of any markings on the steering rack and radiator).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: no guaranteed fit; scrap/parts value only.

proof_requests: Photos of both axle shafts (each one clearly visible end-to-end) and the starter motor (clearly identifiable).
Close-up photos of the steering rack boots/ends and any part numbers/labels.
Close-up photos of radiator/condenser end tanks and full fin condition (show dents/bends).
Photo or video proof of the certified scale weighing the full lot (show the reading).
Any markings/part numbers or the donor car make/model/year for compatibility.
response.reason: From photo 0, only a steering rack/gear and a radiator/condenser are clearly visible; the axle shafts and starter motor are not shown, and the stated 500 kg certified weight is not provable from photos. Without proof of completeness and condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
